working_title: Quantum Tunneling: How Particles Pass Through Solid Barriers

script.hook: In our world, throwing a ball at a brick wall means it bounces back... but in the quantum world, it passes right through!
script.body_1: This is Quantum Tunneling. Subatomic particles behave like probability waves instead of solid spheres.
script.body_2: Because the wave extends past the barrier, there is a real chance the particle instantly materializes on the other side!
script.conclusion: Without quantum tunneling, the Sun couldn't fuse hydrogen, and life on Earth wouldn't exist!
